Title: Spatial transcriptomics reveals tumor microenvironment heterogeneity in colorectal cancer
Authors: Chen Wei; Smith Sarah; Tanaka Yuki
Abstract: Spatial transcriptomics enables the mapping of gene expression within intact tissue sections. We applied spatial transcriptomics to 45 colorectal cancer specimens and identified distinct tumor microenvironment niches.

Title: Machine learning approaches for biomarker discovery in spatially resolved transcriptomic data
Authors: Patel Priya; Mueller Anna; Garcia Maria
Abstract: We developed a graph neural network framework for identifying spatially variable genes and biomarkers from spatial transcriptomics data applied to colorectal cancer tissue microarrays.

Title: Comprehensive spatial multi-omics atlas of colorectal cancer
Authors: Zhang Wei; Johnson James; Andersson Lars
Abstract: This study presents a comprehensive spatial multi-omics atlas integrating spatial transcriptomics proteomics and metabolomics data from 120 colorectal cancer patients.
